question: Who among the following Indian weightlifters won the silver medal in the women's 49 kg division at the World Weightlifting Championships 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saikhom Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saikhom Mirabai Chanu**, won the **silver medal** in the women's **49 kg **division at the **World Weightlifting Championships 2022**.
 
• She is a well-known Indian weightlifter who has won several medals in various international tournaments, including the **2018 Commonwealth Games** and the **2020 Asian Championships**.
 
• Her achievement is significant for Indian weightlifting as she has become the first Indian woman to win a medal at the World Weightlifting Championships since Karnam Malleswari's **bronze in 1995**.
 
• Her success at the World Weightlifting Championships **2022** has also boosted her chances of winning a medal at the upcoming **Tokyo Olympics**, where she will represent India in the women's **49 kg category**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swati Singh**

 
 
• She is a Weightlifter, an Indian.
 
• She won the **bronze** medal in the women's **53 kg** weight class at the Glasgow 2014 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Santoshi Matsa**
 
 
• Weightlifter Santoshi Matsa, an Indian, took home the **silver medal** in the women's** 53 kg **weight class at the Glasgow 2014 Commonwealth Games. 
 
 
 
• **Khumukcham Sanjita Chanu**
 
 
• Weightlifter Khumukcham Sanjita Chanu hails from** India.**
 
• She has won** two Commonwealth **Games titles.
 
• In the women's** 48 kg** and **53 kg** weight categories, Chanu won **gold medals** in both the 2014 Glasgow and 2018 Gold Coast events.
